# Fly Sussex

## Type:Paragliding

Fly Sussex Paragliding, Tollgate, Nr.Lewes, East Sussex, BN8 6JZ

![Fly Sussex](https://eu-assets.simpleview-europe.com/eastbourne/imageresizer/?image=%2Fimages%2Fnoimage.jpg&action=ProductDetailPro)

## About

Take to the skies at Fly Sussex, the UK's largest and longest- established paragliding school in the UK, with 27 years experience. A team of dedicated BHPA qualified instructors are here to teach you to fly throughout the year.
